diff --git a/src/hb-raster-draw.cc b/src/hb-raster-draw.cc
index 5134f7f..e55da9c 100644
--- a/src/hb-raster-draw.cc
+++ b/src/hb-raster-draw.cc
@@ -1767,7 +1767,7 @@ hb_raster_draw_render (hb_raster_draw_t *draw)
 	int64_t cover_accum = use_wide ?
 	  sweep_row_to_alpha_wide (image->buffer.arrayZ + row * ext.stride,
 				   draw->row_area_wide.arrayZ, draw->row_cover_wide.arrayZ,
-				   x_min, x_max) :
+				   0, x_max) :
 	  sweep_row_to_alpha (image->buffer.arrayZ + row * ext.stride,
 			      draw->row_area.arrayZ, draw->row_cover.arrayZ,
 			      x_min, x_max);

coupling: The earlier raster clipping commit changes x_max from an inclusive cell index to an exclusive right edge. It updates the narrow sweep, SIMD bounds, row condition, and tail fill consistently, so that commit alone is safe. The later accumulator commit adds a separate wide sweep for dense rows. Its wide converter still loops through x_max inclusively, and the edited call sweeps the full prefix through that shared bound. Against the original inclusive convention the later edit is safe; combined with the earlier exclusive convention it reads cover[width] when an edge reaches the rightmost column. Correct repair requires tracing the boundary contract across both commits and changing the wide converter or its call. Changing only the later full-prefix start back to x_min, or only the earlier narrow-loop bounds, leaves the wide out-of-bounds read reachable.

pocs.entry_point: hb_raster_draw_get_funcs() draw callbacks followed by hb_raster_draw_render()
